description: Network switch port discovery tool using CDP/LLDP/MNDP.
longDescription: PortFinder captures CDP, LLDP, and MNDP packets to identify what switch, port, and VLAN your device is connected to. Cross-platform (macOS + Windows + Linux). On macOS the bundled BPF helper grants non-root access to /dev/bpf*; on Linux the .deb / .rpm sets CAP_NET_RAW on the binary; on Windows it links delay-loaded against Npcap so the app launches even if Npcap isn't installed yet (the in-app banner walks the user through the install).
